description: Hey, I'm a music producer and artist. I create music for various media, including games, films, commercials, VTubers, and more. If you're interested in commissioning a piece or have any questions, feel free to reach out to me.

packages.title: Full Original Song Production
packages.shortDesc: Completely custom original song from scratch in your desired style/genre.
includes: Standard delivery includes WAV (48 kHz/24-bit) and MP3 files
addons: Extra length: +$120 per additional 30 seconds past 4 min
Commercial/streaming upload rights: contact to discuss (see ToS §5)
details: Before requesting, please ensure you have a detailed concept for the song ready. This does not have to include any specific musical ideas, just a general vision for the song's direction. Song references are encouraged!
I can work in any genre depending on your request, but I specialise in pop and electronic music. The price may increase depending on how challenging the work is
Lyrics are NOT included. Please ensure you can write your own lyrics or are working with a lyricist.

Please ensure you have a high-quality vocal recording setup with minimal background noise and reverb, and a good-quality microphone. The quality of the song depends on the quality of the recordings, so bear that in mind.

packages.title: Vocal Mix & Master
packages.shortDesc: Professional cleaning, tuning, mixing and mastering of your vocal recordings.
includes: Noise removal, de-essing, tuning & timing correction
Balanced mix with your provided instrumental
addons: Additional vocal layers / harmonies: +$25 per track

packages.title: Loopable BGM / Background Music
packages.shortDesc: Seamless, loopable ambient or thematic background music for streams, games or videos.

tos.title: IMPORTANT
tos.content:
- By submitting a request for the services and/or remitting payment, you agree to be legally bound by all the terms and conditions outlined in this Agreement (the "Agreement").
- I have the right to decline the commission if I feel that I do not meet the requirements of your request.

tos.title: PAYMENT
tos.content: A non-refundable deposit of 50% is required to begin work. The remaining 50% must be paid upon completion, before the final files are delivered. Final files will not be sent before full payment is received.

tos.title: REVISIONS
tos.content: Each package includes the stated number of revisions. Any major changes (e.g. a genre shift, a structural overhaul or a new concept) will be treated as a new order. Additional revision rounds are charged at $40 each.

tos.title: DEADLINE & DELIVERY
tos.content:
- The turnaround time is 4–5 weeks from the initial start date, unless stated otherwise.
- Projects with specific deadlines will be prioritised, but may be subject to a rush fee.
- Work-in-progress version of tracks will be given at a lower audio quality than the final delivery.
- Standard delivery includes WAV (48 kHz/24-bit) and MP3 files. Stems, MIDI files and project files are not included as standard and must be purchased separately.

tos.title: COPYRIGHT & USAGE RIGHTS
tos.content:
- I retain all rights to the composition and final version of the song. I may include the song in a discography, showreel or portfolio.
- The Client is granted a perpetual license to use the work according to the purchased tier.
- The finished results do not include commercial permits. If you want to commercialise them, there will be an additional cost of 100% of the initial cost or more. This includes selling your songs as digital products, such as distributing them to Spotify or other related platforms, via physical CDs/vinyl, and all other sales related to the results.

tos.title: COMMUNICATION & INACTIVITY
tos.content:
- You can contact me via Discord (@hikorii6) or by email (riruerii+contact@proton.me). I recommend contacting me on Discord for faster communication.
- Feel free to contact me at any time if you would like an update on your commission.
- Clients are expected to respond promptly. If a project has been inactive for more than 30 days with no communication, it may be cancelled and the deposit will not be refunded.

tos.title: CREDIT & ATTRIBUTION
tos.content:
- As with any other collaborators, the clients must credit me as 'riruerii' on whichever platform they choose to release or use the work. Please include a link to my Twitter and website.
If you decide to share it on social media, please tag me, @rdwnriel, alongside the credits for your other collaborators.
- Co-primary artist credit is not included by default and may be negotiated separately under a collaboration agreement.

tos.title: CANCELATION & REFUND
tos.content:
- If the necessary creative materials are not received within twenty-four hours of the client submitting the form or agreeing to the terms, the composer reserves the right to cancel the request and keep any non-refundable deposit (if applicable).
- If I am unable to deliver the product for any reason, whether due to difficulty or major personal circumstances, you will receive a full refund. You will be informed in advance if this becomes a possibility.
- If the client cancels after work has commenced, the deposit will remain non-refundable. 
- If the client cancels mid-project, they may be required to pay additional fees depending on how much work has been completed.
